description: Authentic documentary rendering with professional tonal finishing, natural color, meaningful subject separation, and faithful preservation of atmosphere and context.
editing_goals: Produce a professionally finished documentary image while preserving the authenticity of the recorded scene.
Improve tonal separation, visibility, and subject emphasis without altering the visual story.
Maintain realistic available-light color and environmental atmosphere.
Enhance detail only where it improves readability and visual communication.
Deliver a polished image suitable for editorial and documentary stock libraries without introducing stylistic interpretation.
cautions: Never create an HDR or tone-mapped appearance.
Avoid excessive shadow lifting that changes the mood of the scene.
Avoid crushed blacks that hide important documentary detail.
Avoid exaggerated color, excessive Texture, Clarity, or Dehaze.
Avoid halos or obvious local processing.
Crop only when it clearly improves composition without changing documentary context.
Do not leave the image looking unfinished in the name of authenticity.

guidance: Correct only obvious accidental camera roll.
Do not force formal geometry if it changes the documentary character of the image.
Prioritize truthful presentation over visual perfection.
